controls.name: Summary tiles
controls.what: HITL interventions per slice (with average time), typical cost per card, cards finished this month.

controls.name: Cost strip (not drawn)
controls.what: One dot per finished card by cost, a dashed line at the 80th percentile, "80% of cards cost under $X"; tapping a dot opens the card. The per-card limit is read from it.

controls.name: Role and Model filters
controls.what: Filter cards by role and by the model that answered.

controls.name: Card labels
controls.what: Complete or Closed, plus Interrupted when the card needed Todd.
notes: Stitch's pills (High cost, Frugal run, Multi-round) are not built (0065).

controls.name: Card numbers
controls.what: Time, rounds, HITL interventions and cost, each against the typical finished card, for example "3× typical cost".

controls.name: Time per stage (not drawn)
controls.what: One bar per stage with the typical time a finished card spends there, split machine working and waiting on Todd; tapping a stage shows its playbook steps' typical times and its slowest cards.

controls.name: "Failed the first time" (not drawn)
controls.what: "Failed the first time: 7 of 120 lines", opening every line ever Not proven with its card, the checker's reason and whether the next round fixed it.
